import os,json,subprocess,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
os.sched_setaffinity(0,{1});root=Path('/home/root/y26_continuous30');stage='smoke';o=root/'results'/stage;o.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False);rows=[]
def irq():return [sum(map(int,l.split()[1:3])) for l in Path('/proc/interrupts').read_text().splitlines() if 'xilinx-dma-controller' in l]
before=irq();modes=['cpu','pl21','pl30'];gold={'cpu':'c3d76a81fafb73bcfed120f3babeb9646909edd1d21d6ab7a30faa3aca3d69c8','pl21':'2ca8684aa0d6c348300bfffd5aacf2c4869cc58928a38819219245210a8730bc','pl30':'6cd6b3bd357c3c46688870b85d83bd34de92d55288cd429160f47224ca09427a'}
for rid in range(1 if stage=='smoke' else 7):
 for mode in modes[rid%3:]+modes[:rid%3]:
  out=o/str(rid)/mode;out.mkdir(parents=True)
  cmd=[str(root/'y26-continuous30-check'),'--param','/home/root/Zynq7020_deploy/model.ncnn.param','--bin','/home/root/Zynq7020_deploy/model.ncnn.bin','--rgb',str(root/'input.rgb'),'--package',str(root),'--output-dir',str(out),'--backend',mode,'--capture','1' if stage=='smoke' else '0','--warmup','0' if stage=='smoke' else '2','--runs','1']
  v=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120);assert v.returncode==0,(mode,v.stderr)
  report=json.loads((out/'report.json').read_text());h=hashlib.sha256((out/'output.f32').read_bytes()).hexdigest();assert h==gold[mode],(mode,h)
  if mode!='cpu':
   p=report['profile'];assert (p['transactions'],p['tx_bytes'],p['rx_bytes'],p['hardware_errors'])==((47,2911888,289792,0) if mode=='pl30' else (34,2114768,437312,0))
  if mode=='pl30' and stage=='smoke':
   assert (out/'conv30.i8').read_bytes()==(root/'reference30.i8').read_bytes();assert (out/'conv10.i8').read_bytes()==(root/'conv10.i8').read_bytes();assert (out/'conv20.i8').read_bytes()==(root/'reference20.i8').read_bytes()
  rows.append({'round':rid,'mode':mode,'report':report,'output_sha256':h});print(rid,mode,report['forward_ms'],flush=True)
after=irq();expected=81 if stage=='smoke' else 1701;assert [a-b for a,b in zip(after,before)]==[expected,expected]
(o/'done.json').write_text(json.dumps({'passed':True,'irq_before':before,'irq_after':after,'records':rows}))
